description: This Java class 'StatusTracker' manages the lifecycle statuses of activities in an Android application, maintaining a map of activity status states and providing methods to update, retrieve, and clear these statuses. It also tracks the sequence of method calls related to activity statuses.

classes.name: StatusTracker
classes.description: Singleton class that tracks the statuses of activities, including methods to set, get, and clear statuses, as well as retrieving method call sequences.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the StatusTracker class.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a given activity and records the activity method call.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the current status of a specified activity.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored activity statuses and method call history.

methods.name: getMethodList
methods.description: Returns the list of activity method calls.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns the set of activity names for which statuses are stored.
